scope: Canonical CPU plant-surface callback and shared coarse water query, not a native plant renderer, new terrain model, stream scheduler or collision population.

contract.ownership: Borrows the caller's existing field. TerrainStream::field and launch_site::canonical_world_field already own the source-checked canonical Arc; no new loader/provider/cache is introduced.
contract.input_precondition: Finite body-fixed unit direction, guaranteed by scatter_region; direct field queries do not add a fallible validation/normalization layer.
contract.ground: Exact final sample_surface/height_m at fixed 32m cutoff, including attached global/regional erosion and retained analytic bands; no storage quantization or vertical offset.
contract.placement_slope: Existing metric surface_geometry at 32m, centred +/-16m; not sample_surface's zero hint or historical sample's approximate slope.
contract.ecology: Same final 32m semantic sample with existing shared material 256m geometry slope (+/-128m); not a query/camera/density-dependent habitat model.
contract.water: PlanetField::water_height_m: maximum of ocean datum zero and non-saline basin levels at the existing nearest hydrology cell. Uses actual hydrology dimensions, not climate-context dimensions.
contract.identity: Fixed-address kernel, seed/hash channels, world-local IDs, existing density/eligibility policy and historical IDs/wire format unchanged. No fabricated rock-density noise.
contract.offline: Historical frozen-DEM plant callback retains its height/cover/+/-32m slope behavior. Water lookup is extracted unchanged and shared; arbitrary accepted unsorted offline artifacts retain historical behavior. Only the runtime field-owned lake copies are normalized.

review_regression.finding: FrozenSurface::validate accepts unsorted lake cells while binary membership lookup assumes sorting. The bundled producer sorts cells, but source-compatible accepted input can silently lose standing water.
review_regression.before_scope: Intermediate new adapter before field-copy normalization, not a claim that the baseline had this new public sampler.
review_regression.fixture: Reverse an existing freshwater lake's cell list in the complete bundled source-compatible artifact; assert frozen validation and attachment accept it.
review_regression.fix: sort_unstable only on field-owned cloned lake cells during attachment; do not mutate input, tighten frozen validation or change historical offline lookup.
review_regression.after: Every affected cell exactly matches the sorted-control field; field cell order normalized, original artifact remains reversed.

81-point material/ecology semantic comparison with a non-vacuous distinction from placement-scale reeds.
Attached 0.5-degree freshwater membership versus 2-degree climate context, saline exclusion and otherwise-eligible plants rejected by real lake levels.
Shared helper ocean fallback, maximum level, nearest-cell rounding, seam/pole endpoints.

Known-special-case geometry truncation coverage reuses existing stencil tests; no new derivative implementation.
numerical_limits: Fixed 32m cutoff is not 32m resolved erosion or metre-scale root/contact accuracy. Smooth central derivative component truncation <= max_abs_third_derivative*d^2/6 at d=16m placement /128m ecology, before floating-point error. No universal derivative/error envelope across DEM triangles, clamps, noise or blend boundaries. Bundled regional erosion remains nominally256m. Water cells are0.5degrees (~27.93km meridional, nearest-cell support +/-13.96km), not shoreline-position error bounds or resolved channels/ponds. Geometry uses the existing datum-sphere metric.
